column3: The Hebrew explicitly places the plate on the turban “above”; BSB omits that positional word.
The Hebrew repeats the doing clause, ending “so they did”; BSB states the Israelites’ obedience once.
The Hebrew says “the pure lampstand,” without explicitly naming gold in this verse. BSB adds “gold” and combines “its lamps, the lamps of the arrangement” into “its row of lamps.”
The Hebrew includes “and behold” and repeats “they did” in its account of the work; BSB condenses these into the statement that they had accomplished it.
